title: Save & Switch with a blank name reports saved and drops every Settings edit
impact_why: silent loss of user edits behind a success path on the agent switch flow
predicted_why: like 9df2764add (git, decision memory empty), accepted: "missing health reads 'Health unknown', never Healthy" - a status that claims success it did not have
instrument: vitest: saveAll on a blank-name dirty settings draft must reject with TabSaveError listing settings
body:
## Summary
When the agent name is blank, the Settings save group returns without writing, the save registry counts that as success, and Save & Switch (or the leave-section guard) switches away, discarding every other Settings edit.

## Description
performSettingsSave skips the write for a blank name (src/features/agents/sub_editor/libs/useEditorSave.ts:173) by RETURNING, so the promise resolves. EditorDocument.saveAll treats a resolved save as persisted and marks the tab clean (src/features/agents/sub_editor/libs/EditorDocument.tsx:168-170). usePersonaSwitchGuard then clears all dirty state and commits the switch (src/features/agents/sub_editor/hooks/usePersonaSwitchGuard.ts:31,47-48); the nav guard in EditorBody.tsx:88-90 does the same. The comment at useEditorSave.ts:168-170 promises "the tab stays dirty so the user fixes it first" - true only for the debounced path. Fixed: the explicit save path rejects for a blank name so saveAll reports Settings as failed (TabSaveError) and the switch is held, while the debounced path keeps skipping silently.

## Flow
- User clears the name field and changes description/colour in Settings
- User clicks another agent -> Unsaved banner -> Save & Switch
- saveAll -> performSettingsSave returns early (useEditorSave.ts:173) -> tab marked clean (EditorDocument.tsx:170)
- switch guard clears dirty + commits switch -> description/colour edits are gone, no toast

## Expected impact
Users who blank the name mid-edit no longer lose their other Settings edits behind a success path; they get "Couldn't save Settings" and stay. Could break: a caller that relied on saveAll resolving with a blank name (none found).

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - an unsaveable Settings draft is reported as failed, never as saved
Before: traced: saveAll resolves and marks settings clean for a blank-name draft (useEditorSave.ts:173 + EditorDocument.tsx:168-170)
After: saveAll rejects with TabSaveError(failedTabs: [settings]) for the same draft; debounced autosave does not fire for a blank name
Method: gate - renderHook test of useEditorSave inside EditorDirtyProvider calling the store saveAll with a blank-name dirty draft; red on base, green after
Result: better
Gate: none

title: Deep fan-out switch cannot be turned off when the capability probe fails
impact_why: a prompt directive stays stuck on a persona after a probe hiccup or downgrade
predicted_why: no precedent (door decisions empty; none in cycle-1 git)
instrument: vitest RTL: probe rejects + persisted ON -> toggle enabled
body:
## Summary
DeepFanoutToggle disables the switch whenever the capability probe says unavailable OR fails, even when the persisted flag is ON, so a persona already fanning out cannot be switched back.

## Description
A probe rejection sets available=false (src/features/agents/sub_editor/components/DeepFanoutToggle.tsx:64), and available===false disables the toggle unconditionally (:106) while `on` still reads the persisted true. A plan downgrade does the same. Turning a capability OFF never needs the capability. Fixed: the switch is held only when it would turn the flag ON.

## Flow
- Persona has deep_fanout=true persisted
- probeCliCapabilities rejects (or plan lacks Workflow/Task) -> available=false
- Switch renders checked + disabled -> user cannot turn the directive off

## Expected impact
Operators can always remove the parallel-delegation directive. Could break: nothing - enabling stays gated.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - an enabled capability can always be disabled
Before: traced: on=true, available=false -> toggle disabled (DeepFanoutToggle.tsx:106)
After: on=true, available=false -> toggle enabled; clicking writes deep_fanout off
Method: gate - RTL test: probe rejects, parameters carry deep_fanout=true -> switch not disabled, click calls updatePersona without the flag
Result: better
Gate: none

title: Quick stats show the previous agent's numbers after a switch once a run completed
impact_why: wrong agent's success/cost figures in the header during load
predicted_why: like 9df2764add (git, decision memory empty), accepted: "missing health reads 'Health unknown', never Healthy"
body:
## Summary
useQuickStats only shows its skeleton when reloadTick is 0 and never clears executions on a persona change, so after any run completion the header shows the old agent's success rate, latency and cost under the new agent until the new fetch lands.

## Description
src/features/agents/sub_editor/hooks/useQuickStats.ts:73 gates the skeleton on reloadTick===0; the effect (:68-86) re-fires on personaId but leaves `executions` holding the previous persona's rows. The header is not remounted per persona (src/features/personas/PersonasPage.tsx:451). If the new fetch fails, the stale rows are replaced by [] only then. Fixed: a personaId change resets executions and shows the skeleton.

## Flow
- Agent A open; a run completes (reloadTick=1)
- Switch to agent B -> effect fires, loading not set, executions still A's
- Header shows A's stats beside B's name until B's list resolves

## Expected impact
Header stats always belong to the agent on screen. Could break: nothing.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - stats never cross agents
Before: traced: after reloadTick>0 a switch keeps prior stats visible while the fetch is pending
After: switch -> stats null and loading true until B resolves
Method: gate - renderHook (existing useQuickStats harness): p1 resolves, emit completion, rerender p2 with a pending fetch -> stats null
Result: better
Gate: none

title: Starred-only and tag filters empty every non-run Activity tab they are offered on
impact_why: a reachable control produces a false-empty feed on five tabs
predicted_why: like 9df2764add (git, decision memory empty), accepted: "missing health reads 'Health unknown', never Healthy" - a status that claims success it did not have
instrument: vitest RTL ActivityTab harness (mocks as in activityTabRunsRegion.test.tsx)
body:
## Summary
The Starred-only toggle and tag select stay visible on the Events/Memories/Reviews/Messages/Attention tabs, but they keep only execution rows, which those tabs never contain - so turning either on always yields "no activity".

## Description
ActivityTab narrows starred/tag to `i.type === 'execution'` (src/features/agents/sub_activity/ActivityTab.tsx:226,231) after the type filter at :217, so on a non-execution tab the result is always empty. ActivityFilters renders both controls whenever the secondary strip is shown (src/features/agents/sub_activity/ActivityFilters.tsx:75-102), and switching tab only resets the status filter (:53) - a starred toggle set on All silently empties Events. Fixed: the run-only controls show (and apply) only where runs are listed (the All tab).

## Flow
- Activity tab -> Events -> press Starred only
- filtered = events.filter(type === execution && starred) -> []
- Table renders the "no activity" empty state for a persona with events

## Expected impact
Users filtering Events/Memories never see a false empty feed. Could break: nothing; the All tab keeps both filters.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - a filter is only offered where it can match rows
Before: traced: on 5 of 6 non-run tabs Starred/tag yield 0 rows whatever the data
After: controls absent on those tabs and a stale starred state no longer empties them
Method: gate - RTL test of ActivityTab: Events tab with events present, starred toggled on All first -> rows still shown; starred control absent on Events
Result: better
Gate: none

title: Corrupt model-profile guard pauses autosave but Save & Switch still overwrites it
evidence:
src/features/agents/sub_editor/libs/useEditorSave.ts:229  enabled: !!selectedPersonaId && !pendingPersonaId && !suppressModelSave,
src/features/agents/sub_editor/libs/useEditorSave.ts:91-92  The user must explicitly re-select a model to unblock.
grep suppressModelSave|modelProfileCorrupt -> only useEditorDraft.ts:40,48 and useEditorSave.ts:93,96,229
impact_why: overwrites a recoverable model config the UI promised to protect
predicted_why: no precedent (door decisions empty; none in cycle-1 git)
instrument: vitest renderHook: corrupt profile + dirty model group -> store saveAll does not call applyPersonaOp with SwitchModel
body:
## Summary
When the stored model_profile is unparseable, autosave of model fields is suppressed to protect the recoverable JSON, but the same save is still registered for saveAll, so Save & Switch or the leave guard writes the reset profile over it.

## Description
suppressModelSave gates only the debounced section (src/features/agents/sub_editor/libs/useEditorSave.ts:229); the registry save is the same saveModelSettings (:206-209) and EditorDocument.saveAll calls every dirty tab's save (src/features/agents/sub_editor/libs/EditorDocument.tsx:140-170). The option doc says "the user must explicitly re-select a model to unblock" (useEditorSave.ts:91-92) - nothing implements an unblock: suppressModelSave is derived from the persisted blob only (src/features/agents/sub_editor/hooks/useEditorDraft.ts:40,48), grep finds no other writer. Fixed: decide one rule (explicit re-select unblocks both paths, or both paths refuse) and pin it.

## Flow
- Persona with corrupt model_profile opens; banner warns; model fields reset in draft
- User edits max budget (model group dirty; autosave suppressed)
- User switches agent -> Save & Switch -> saveAll -> performModelSave writes the reset profile
- The still-recoverable original JSON is overwritten

## Expected impact
The protection the banner promises holds on every save path. Could break: a user who wants to save budget edits must re-select a model first (the documented rule).

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - the corrupt-profile guard holds on both save paths
Before: traced: debounced path suppressed; explicit saveAll path writes SwitchModel
After: neither path writes SwitchModel until the unblock rule is met
Method: simulation - the unblock rule is a behaviour decision the code never made; a renderHook test of saveAll is the instrument once the rule is chosen
Result: better
Gate: none

title: A failed report delete closes its modal; a failed review verdict keeps it open
evidence:
src/features/agents/sub_activity/ActivityModals.tsx:96-98  await deleteReport(selectedMessage.id).catch(toastCatch(...)); setSelectedMessage(null); onDataChanged();
src/features/agents/sub_activity/ActivityModals.tsx:51  setSelectedReview(null); (success branch only)
impact_why: minor retry friction after a failed delete
predicted_why: like 9df2764add (git, decision memory empty), accepted: "deploy failures surface the real backend error" - failure paths keep the user in place to act
body:
## Summary
In the same modal hook, a failed review verdict keeps the modal open so the decision stays in hand, but a failed report delete toasts and then closes the modal anyway.

## Description
handleReviewAction only clears the selection on success (src/features/agents/sub_activity/ActivityModals.tsx:51) with a comment explaining why. The report onDelete awaits deleteReport(...).catch(toastCatch) and then unconditionally closes and refreshes (:96-98), so the user loses the report view right after being told the delete failed. Fixed: close only when the delete landed.

## Flow
- Activity -> Messages -> open report -> Delete -> confirm
- deleteReport rejects -> toast
- setSelectedMessage(null) still runs -> modal closes, user must find the report again to retry

## Expected impact
Retrying a failed delete is one click. Could break: activityReportDelete.test still passes (toast pinned).

## Evaluation
Claim: user - a failed destructive action leaves the user where they can retry
Before: traced: modal closed after failure (ActivityModals.tsx:96-97)
After: modal still open after failure; closes after success
Method: gate - extend activityReportDelete.test: after a rejected delete the report modal is still rendered
Result: better
Gate: none

title: Save & Switch gives no busy state while every tab saves
evidence:

src/features/agents/sub_editor/hooks/usePersonaSwitchGuard.ts:26  if (isSwitchingRef.current) return;

body:
## Summary
The unsaved-changes banner's Save & Switch is a plain Button; during saveAll it neither spins nor disables, and a second click is silently ignored by a ref.

## Description
src/features/agents/sub_editor/components/EditorBanners.tsx:83 renders Save & Switch without loading/disabled; usePersonaSwitchGuard drops re-entry with isSwitchingRef (src/features/agents/sub_editor/hooks/usePersonaSwitchGuard.ts:26) but exposes no state. On a slow IPC the user sees nothing happen. The repo convention is Button loading (cycle-1 "Refresh on Button loading"). Proposed: the guard exposes isSwitching; the banner passes loading to the save button and disables Discard while it runs.

## Flow
- Click Save & Switch with a slow save
- Banner unchanged for the save duration; clicks ignored

## Expected impact
Feedback during the switch save. Could break: nothing.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - a running save shows as running
Before: busy indicator during saveAll: none (traced)
After: save button loading, discard disabled
Method: gate - RTL test on UnsavedChangesBanner with a saving prop
Result: better
Gate: none

title: Entering or leaving the Runs tab refetches all five other Activity feeds
impact_why: redundant local IPC; freshness side-effect lost
predicted_why: no precedent (door decisions empty; none in cycle-1 git); the refetch is the only refresh the tab has, so removing it may read as a regression
body:
## Summary
loadData depends on runsRegionOwnsExecutions, so every switch into or out of the Runs tab rebuilds it and re-fires the event, memory, review, report and attention IPC reads.

## Description
src/features/agents/sub_activity/ActivityTab.tsx:184 lists runsRegionOwnsExecutions in loadData's deps and :194 reruns loadData on identity change. Switching Events -> Runs -> Events costs ten feed IPCs where the five non-run feeds did not change. Fixed: split the execution fetch from the other five so the tab toggle only affects the execution feed.

## Flow
- Activity -> Events (5 reads) -> Runs (5 reads again) -> Events (5 more)

## Expected impact
Fewer redundant reads; tab switches feel instant. Could break: users who relied on tab-toggling as a refresh (no refresh affordance otherwise exists).

## Evaluation
Claim: performance - IPC reads per tab toggle
Before: listMemories calls over Events->Runs->Events: 3 (traced)
After: 1
Method: probe - count mocked listMemories calls in an RTL test across the toggle sequence
Result: better
Gate: none
